About

Artificial intelligence is my specialty, and its impact on people's lives is what gives my work its meaning. I work in deep learning, explainable AI, and intelligent agents, and I see the value of these technologies when they help catch a disease early, ease a pilgrim's journey, open a door for a student, or enable an organization to build its own capabilities and take off with them.

That purpose joins the tracks of my work. In health, I develop models that read the body's signals to support early detection of disease, and that explain the grounds of their findings to help clinicians decide. In Hajj and Umrah, the work carries personal meaning: I am a daughter of Mecca, and serving those who journey to it is an extension of my belonging to it. From that place, I led the Training and Awareness Track of the Nusuk Card initiative and filed a patent application for an AI-powered kiosk serving pilgrims.

In education and talent empowerment, I lead KITE to open global horizons for King Abdulaziz University's students, chair the Rhodes Scholarship Preparation Initiative, and work with Mawhiba to grow young talent. I also advise organizations and individuals on building AI capabilities they can develop and invest in independently.

I believe knowledge extends through every person we empower. The impact I aspire to is the kind that continues after my part ends: people who open doors for others, and organizations that keep growing on the capabilities they built.

Projects & prototypes

Ideas become real when they leave the slide deck. A glimpse of what I am building.

Healthcare

Healthcare AI Institute

An AI transformation partner for healthcare and pharmaceutical organizations: strategy, capability building, and solutions. The aim is smarter, faster care decisions, delivered by teams that own the technology themselves.

Health

NORA

An AI reasoning agent that validates biomarker evidence in blood-sample sequencing data. The aim is catching cancer earlier, with a test far gentler on the patient than a biopsy.

Hajj & Umrah

Kanaf

Kanaf is an intelligent agent that elevates the quality of life of the guests of the Sacred House of God: it understands their need, anticipates their question, and connects them to the most fitting service, at its right time and in the way that suits them.

Empowerment

COMPASS

A platform that turns academic advising from scattered paperwork into clear, trackable plans. The aim is a student who knows the path, and an advisor who sees it with them.

Empowerment

Smart KITE

The architecture and roadmap of the KITE student excellence initiative. The aim is King Abdulaziz University students competing for global opportunities, and winning them.

Impact

Tahawwal

An interactive cultural game about the heritage of the Aseer region. The aim is children who know their roots and love them.

Health

Prevention Tree

An interactive Arabic-language awareness prototype. The aim is prevention concepts that reach families in their own language.

Empowerment

Interview Practice

A tool for rehearsing job interviews with instant feedback. The aim is a graduate who walks into the real interview confident and prepared.

Exploration

KoraVibe

An AI concept around football and the stadium experience. The aim is a matchday that feels smoother and more alive for the fans.

Publications
